clue.text: Serene massage involves cleansing processes

explanation.definitionFit: A euphemistic description: an enema flushes out the bowel, a cleansing process in the most literal medical sense.

clue.text: Bring up former lover, Northern Irish politician

explanation.definitionFit: A literal sense of 'bring up': a buried body is raised out of the earth when it is disinterred.

clue.text: Law bringing back tool of corporal punishment — people taken in by empty threat

to be taken in is to be drawn inside

clue.text: Central American once held in Alcatraz, technically

explanation.walkthrough: 'Once' belongs to the definition, not to the prison story: it marks a people of the past.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by history: the Aztecs ruled central Mexico before the Spanish conquest, so they are Central Americans of former times.

clue.text: Method applied by swimmer

the roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A coach describes the technique a swimmer uses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swimmer' is a fish, not an athlete: crosswords often call fish swimmers, and the roach is a common river fish.

clue.text: See 9

a quest is an adventurous journey

clue.text: Athletic Bard taking in area around Grand Canyon — wow!

parts.note: A for athletic, as in AAA, the Amateur Athletic Association

AZ, the postal code of Arizona, the state containing the Grand Canyon

explanation.walkthrough: A setter often means himself by his own pseudonym, so Bard is ME, not Shakespeare.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym as verbs: to wow an audience is to astonish it.

clue.text: Problems in birdwatching hut's sloping surface

clue.text: Pick up complaint on vessel, getting chest pain

clue.text: Queen to feel poorly and lose heart

parts.note: Qu. is an abbreviation of queen
to ail is to be unwell

explanation.walkthrough: Queen is QU here, not the usual Q or ER, so the U is not spare.

clue.text: Art graduate finally got uniform paint finish

explanation.walkthrough: MAT is a variant spelling of matt, the dull even finish that is the opposite of gloss.

clue.text: Sees anger somehow as enthusiasm

clue.text: Tales told about Midlands conference venue — ecstasy dropped into …

clue.text: … elderflower fizz for union leaders — giggling at first, journalist was beaming

clue.text: Weary and overweight, I suppose not having any seconds

clue.text: Hotel ordered bachelor to leave unseen

clue.text: Euros accepted by special advisors in Westminster — they help dig up dirt

clue.text: Rector's fund repaired crypts
